# Support

This repository is a local Safari installer and configuration profiles. It is not a hosted service.

- **How to install:** [README.md](../README.md)
- **Lockdown Mode (Level 3):** [src/lockdown.html](../src/lockdown.html)
- **MDM / Supervised:** [src/mdm.html](../src/mdm.html) (4.1, no erase) · [src/wipe.html](../src/wipe.html) · [src/configurator.html](../src/configurator.html) (4.2, erases)
- **Bugs and features:** GitHub issues (use the templates)
- **Security:** [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)

We cannot remotely configure someone else’s iPhone. If a leftover Settings tap is still on, that is Apple’s limit, not a broken install.
